verdict.rationale: Rippling's developer llms.txt names an official npm package, @rippling/rippling-sdk, and tells builders to check the registry before pinning a version. That sits on top of a documented v2 REST API with Bearer-token auth, dated version pinning, and cursor pagination. The SDK itself appears only as a one-line mention, with no usage docs, language coverage, or hands-on confirmation. missing for 10: SDK reference docs and usage examples, evidence of SDKs beyond a single JavaScript/npm package, independent or hands-on corroboration that the SDK works against the IT product APIs.
